scope: Optative first-person singular/plural, negation and ability combinations
findings: Explicit gel/yap verb roots accept gelelim/yapalım/gelebilelim, but reject geleyim/yapayım/gelebileyim. Source has opt1pl rule103 but no corresponding opt1sg rule.

Negative plural gelmeyelim/yapmayalım and inability plural gelemeyelim are rejected; imperative/optative rules originate only at verbRoot, not afterNegation. This overlaps round55 negative continuation family.

Flat vocabulary protects some rejected forms such as geleyim/yapmayalım. Production morphology also accepts yapayım via a path not present in isolated yap root graph; exact alternate analysis not traced.
classification: Morphology coverage gaps, no observed center-touch corruption in this corpus; do not conflate the two.
validation: Two targeted diagnostic tests passed; no UI or offset followup.
next_step: Investigate broader app interactions or follow corpus OOV cases only where new evidence suggests actual ranking risk.
